tasks.label: Ejecutar archivo
tasks.command: switch ('${fileExtname}') { '.dart' { dart run '${file}' }; '.java' { javac '${file}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { java -cp '${fileDirname}' '${fileBasenameNoExtension}' } }; '.py' { python '${file}' }; '.js' { node '${file}' }; default { Write-Host 'Tipo de archivo no compatible: ${fileExtname}' } }

tasks.label: Flutter: Reiniciar Android
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM emulator.exe 2>$null; taskkill /F /IM qemu-system-x86_64.exe 2>$null; adb kill-server; adb start-server

tasks.label: Flutter: Detener procesos
tasks.command: cd android; .\gradlew --stop; cd ..; Get-Process java,dart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
